findings.message: Fresh independent review of the regenerated receipts aiact-fria-republication-001.json and gdpr-dpia-republication-001.json: 12/12 evidence items verified against their ingest units (locators, source hashes, unit content hashes, authority).

12/12 section bindings traced to the proposed future-vault notes; every obligation statement rests on reviewed BINDING sources (SRC-0010, SRC-0011); SRC-0022 guidance uses remain visibly marked non-binding.

Evidence lock regenerated deterministically: 60 unique evidence refs, 4 receipt hashes matching current files; library resolution returns 60/60 records REVIEWED and 25/25 bindings REVIEWED with no findings.
valid_from/valid_until remain null across SRC-0010, SRC-0011 and SRC-0022; currency dates unverified.
Token-multiset coverage establishes neither layout fidelity nor legal correctness.
No classification event exists for SRC-0022; its GUIDANCE label is author-assigned and confined to visibly marked non-binding uses.
DPIA Summary binding omits SRC-0022 Page 182, which directly supports one clause; Page 181 is cited.
FRIA Applicability gloss omits the Annex III point 5(b) financial-fraud carve-out present on cited SRC-0011 Page 386.
Review bounded to the 12 cited units and four locked receipts; grants no publication approval and no legal conclusion.
